Paprika Baked Chicken Thighs

Yield: 3 servings

Ingredients
- 6 bone-in chicken thighs
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 teaspoons smoked paprika
- 1 teaspoon kosher salt
- ½ teaspoon black pepper
- 1 lemon, juiced

Preparation
1. Rub the chicken with the oil, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
2. Preheat the oven to 425°F.
3. Bake 40 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.
4. Spoon the lemon juice over the top.
